title: Immersive interiors: inside a building only the room exists (door fades, the diorama room camera, who is inside, watch mode, the cabin and decorate, painted windows, sound)
brief:
DESIGN: /tmp/harness/lookfeel/design.md section 1 (LF1) is the binding design, with code anchors. Section 0.1 has the probe numbers; /tmp/harness/lookfeel/interior/ has the pictures (*-now.png today, *-emu.png world hidden, *-target.png the target). Read section 1 in full before writing code. Its line numbers are for /tmp/harness/base-hf.html (e7d8990); your file also has the controls-v3 and guy-only hotfix, seams S0 and L0, LF2 and B27Ta, so find code by function name or quoted anchor. PLAN: /tmp/harness/lookfeel/plan.md (tracks, seam L0, territory, runtime contracts, merge). Sections 0 and 2 of /tmp/harness/round2-spec.md still apply (autonomy, performance, state, truth and IP).
OWNER (Nov 3, on his iPhone): "When you go inside a building, you can really be inside the building and be immersed into it versus just seeing, like that's how it works in Animal Crossing, right? The whole world disappears essentially because now you're really, it's as if you're in the building for real. That's how I would like it to work."
GOAL. Going through an open door fades to warm black and back, and then only that room exists:
- no town, terrain, water, sky, weather, street labels or other buildings; a warm void (#1E1612) beyond the walls
- a fixed three-quarter diorama camera, framed like the approved interior mockups (ghost-town/previews/scene-mock/shots/i1-cafe-*, i2-study-*, i4-cabin-*), that pans with him inside the room
- only the people who are actually in that building
- walking back into the door, or tapping 'Go outside', fades back to the doorstep
- watch mode goes in and out with Mocha
- from the street, buildings are closed (no open fronts or fading shells); who is inside shows through lit windows, door notes and the near pill
Indoor draws fall from about 340-460 to 80-100 or fewer. About 1 to 1.5 hours: CORE is the floor; STRETCH follows in order as time allows.
TRACK T, step 3 of 4 (after LF2 and B27Ta; B27Tb follows on the same file).
- Work in /tmp/harness/b27t/index.html. Append one LF1 entry to /tmp/harness/b27t/ledger.json (never draws.json). Write /tmp/harness/test-LF1.js.
- Probes: copy /tmp/harness/lookfeel/probe/{common,interior,interior2}.js into /tmp/harness/b27t/lf1/ and run them through the redirect: NODE_OPTIONS="--require /tmp/harness/redirect.js" MOCHA_FILE=/tmp/harness/b27t/index.html. Playwright Chromium with SwiftShader; one browser at a time, generous timeouts, retry once.
- From this step on, LF1 owns the 'room' camera, the room void and the indoor shadow fit. B27Ta built them first (pitch .78/.62, STYLE.shadowHalf, the void sky hook, BAKEMI rooms, archwin glass, the CSS room vignette): build on them; do not duplicate or undo them.
CODE PLACEMENT (TDZ; a slip is a boot crash).
- Replace seam L0's IN stub line (in the L0 block right after `const STYLE`) with the full IN of design 1.2. Keep the fields Track S reads: on, pid, ph and see(id).
- WORLD and worldAdd() are declared by seam L0; inWorldBuild() fills WORLD.
- A small LF1 pre-block on the lines right after the seam L0 block holds only data the builders read at boot (CAPM).
- The LF1 main block (hoisted functions and data, plus the one inWorldBuild() call) goes right before the script's final `})();`, after every builder has run.
- Register hooks with STYLE.hooks. Register WINOUT, CAPM and any other new material with PREWARM.add(name,()=>sampleObject).
LEAVE ALONE (Track S territory, seam lines or nobody's; plan.md section 4 has the full table):
- the seam S0 and L0 lines: the SHEETS/UIQ/TIER/PREWARM declarations, the GLOWPTS room-clip lines, the POOLS pid and mask (you only set uniform values and call poolSync()), the RIG.cutT line in wltTick
- frame() outside frameUI: the frame cap, ADAPT, BEND, the render gate and the post pass, HUD.layout, the map line
- updateSky's body (act only through STYLE.skyHooks and STYLE.shadowHalf), the post shader and STYLE.post, resize() and fovK, the GLOWPTS fragment profile, the rest of wltTick
- PAL and AUT, grassTex, roads and walks, the tree batch, DB/dressTown/dressCal, holBuild and holTheme, TOWNTREE
- the thumbnail pipeline (thRender, thumb, thPump, thFill), catBuild/catTick, renderFeed/renderMe/lbItems, panelOpen, toggleMap, the Messages sheet, Settings
- B27Tb's wardrobe and catalog: youParts, LOOK*, ylRender, lookOfItem, fresh()/migrate(), CATSRC/CATB/CATDEC/CATFLV/catMerge
- PLACES, ROADS and NAV; the window.__mocha literal; bake() and BAKEM
CORE, in order. Each item ends with a floor.
C1. The WORLD root (design 1.2).
- inWorldBuild() runs at the end of boot. It moves every top-level scene child into WORLD except the keep-list:
  - the lights: hemi, sun, sun.target, the B16 rig lights, and Mocha's lantern mLight (scene-level since seam L0)
  - the characters and their satellites: mocha, shadowBlob, wisps, bikeObj, petObjs, wObj, visitor, the EMO sprites, TGRING, every scene-level cast object, crowd and test chibis
  - the masked shared batches: GLOWPTS.pts, POOLS.im, the DIM door InstancedMesh and note nodes, b16fx/b16pts, b21notes
- The runtime scene.add sites for environment objects (TPROP umbrellas, the WKV birdhouse and easel, hangProps) call worldAdd(o).
- The leak guard: __mocha.inside().leaks.
- Floor: all.
C2. The IN state machine (design 1.3).
- inTick runs at the top of b12Frame, so roomTick still drives it. Write inStart, inEnter and inLeave.
- The #inFade overlay: fixed, inset 0, #1E1612, pointer-events none, above the canvas and below the HUD; inTick writes its opacity every frame, with no CSS transition.
- Phases: out (.35 s), swap (one frame), hold (at least 2 frames and .08 s), in (.35 s).
- At swap set IN.lock=1 and call the controls-v3 release, ctlRelease(), so no stick or look drag survives the cut. The lock clears once k < .5.
- Triggers: walk in (a permitted door, moving inward), walk out, teleport and spawn (fade-in only; boot included), watch mode (Mocha's AG place stable for .5 s or more, 2.5 s hysteresis), and a walk/follow mode switch.
- ENTERABLE is PLACES with interior and w, kind not 'lot': today's ROOMP plus home and cabin.
- Floor: all.
C3. The room camera (design 1.4).
- inCam(P,who) pushes CAM 'room' at prio 1 with the framing table: pitch .78 in portrait and .62 in landscape and on desktop; yaw P.ry+.30, mirrored to -.30 when the door's local x > w/4; the dist rule. It snaps at swap.
- inTarget clamps to the room rect, or to the current sub-room for places with p.rooms.
- Look drags turn yaw within ±.5 and pitch within .55-1.05, and spring back 2.5 s after the last look input. Pinch zooms within range.
- roomFit and roomPush become aliases of the new code, so hooks and older tests still work.
- Delete cabCamPush and CAM.pop('cabin'): the cabin uses IN.
- Never read camera.fov or camS.dist to size anything; STYLE.fovK compensates after the merge.
- Floor: all. The sub-room clamp may fall back to the whole room.
C4. Closed shells and the cutaway (design 1.4, 1.5 and 1.11).
- Record p.fw in shop(), cottage() and dollhouse().
- Per building, cache an exterior list in P.inX: the direct children of P.obj other than P.inner whose world bounding-box centre lies more than .15 outside the footprint, plus fw, the blade sign, the front glass, the tower and roofShell. Hide it on enter and restore it on leave.
- The per-frame wall cut reuses the existing plane test. It hides only a side or back wall the camera is beyond.
- Wall caps: a shared CAPM (MeshBasic #2A1C18) on the top faces of the back and side walls in shop(), cottage() and dollhouse().
- Outdoors, remove the peek fades (open fronts and fading shells). Keep the occluder fades (occH and occT).
- Floor: all.
C5. Who is drawn (design 1.7).
- IN.see(id) gates Mocha and his satellites (shadowBlob, wisps, pets, his bubble in frameUI), Wendell, CHARLOD townsfolk (before the distance test) and the bike.
- Talking in person needs the same place. Keepers ride with their room.
- Floor: all.
C6. Masks, light and the void (design 1.5 and 1.6).
- DIM: inside, the room's own front door leaf is hidden and back and staff doors show (DIM.pid and DIM.back; diSync for all on enter and leave).
- POOLS: resolve undefined pids with placeAt on first use and call poolSync() on enter and leave. Pools stay visible inside (the seam's b8Frame line).
- GLOWPTS: set the seam's uRoomC and uRoomH on enter and clear them on leave.
- b16fx, b16pts and b21notes emit only for sources in IN.pid.
- rigAssign uses only the IN room's LIGHTSPOTS while inside. The seam already sets RIG.cutT and RIG.cutP.
- The sun shadow uses B27Ta's STYLE.shadowHalf room fit, with sun.target centred on the room, restored on leave.
- The void: clear colour #1E1612 and the fog pushed out while inside, through B27Ta's sky hook, now keyed on IN.on so watch mode and the cabin get it too. Restore on leave; camera.far goes back to TIER.farOut.
- Floor: all.
C7. HUD and taps (design 1.9).
- On enter, set every place label to opacity 0 once. The seam gate already skips the label pass while IN.on.
- The edge chip shows only when Mocha is in this room.
- The near pill:
  - inside, within 2.4 of the front door: '🚪 Go outside'. It is tappable: it tap-goes to the door, and the exit fires on arrival.
  - outside, near a building Mocha is in: '👻 Mocha is inside · {doing}'. A tap walks to the door.
- doorBanner also fires for watch-mode entries.
- tapWorld gets an IN branch: the ray hits the room floor plane, clamped to the room rect minus .4; interact and talk taps test only P.obj descendants and characters that pass IN.see. tapBuilding is skipped.
- Floor: all.
C8. The cabin and decorate (design 1.11).
- cabFrame's inside becomes IN.on&&IN.pid==='cabin'. C.cut and cabCutApply stay.
- dEnter('lot') while inside calls inLeave first. dEnter(room) from outside fades into the cabin and continues at swap. dExit returns to the room view.
- Floor: all.
C9. Verification.
- test-LF1.js and the probes, before and after: draws and tris inside and outside, per building.
- The int_shots views still produce. Work in a copy of the tool in /tmp/harness/b27t/tools/; it may call __mocha.inside.enter first.
- The ledger entry.
- Floor: all.
STRETCH, in priority order:
- S1. WINOUT painted windows (design 1.8):
  - one shared MeshBasic material and one 256 px canvas, with cached states (time of day x weather x season)
  - the tint lerps at 4 Hz in your own tick
  - on Mocha's lancets, the cabin and cottage glass, and B27Ta's archwin glass
  - one painted card (INWIN data) per shop without a side or back window
- S2. Sound (design 1.10): AP.pid=IN.pid inside; the muffled street bed (a bedMk 'muffle' variant); outdoor one-shots muffled or dropped; a door creak at the start and a soft thud at the end.
- S3. The save (design 1.13): boot inside when he was inside and the door still lets him in. Otherwise, the doorstep plus one toast ('🌙 Drizzle & Bean closed while you were away.').
- S4. The CPU early-outs while IN.on (the design 1.14 list).
- S5. Extras: the painted doorway decal at the bottom edge; per-shop window paintings; footsteps by floor type; pre-warming the next room within 4 of its door.
BUDGET.
- Draws inside, main plus shadow: 80 or fewer in shops and the cafe; 100 or fewer in Mocha's house and the cabin.
- Tris inside: 70k or fewer.
- Street views unchanged: the toggle ledger net is 0 outdoors, on frozen frames at DAY=11-03.
- Programs +1 or fewer (WINOUT, registered with PREWARM).
- No new THREE lights; the scene light count never changes on enter or leave. No new save fields.
- Swap: 12 ms or less on desktop SwiftShader, with no shader compile, and no main-thread task over 100 ms at the swap in a 4x-throttled phone profile.
AUTONOMY. IN never writes G.act, G.target, G.mode or G.timer. Mocha's life inside is unchanged; it only becomes visible.
HANDOFF. Report:
- the function names, the keep-list and the per-building exterior counts
- draws and tris inside and outside, per building, and the swap ms
- what the merge glue must re-check: fovK on the room framing; Track S's DB dressing, bunting, strands and jack halos hidden inside; STYLE.post gating under 'room'; LF4's tiers inside
- known_issues
acceptance:
Walk in (the cafe at DAY=11-03 10:30, in 393x852 and 852x393). Place the walker 3 in front of the cafe door facing it and drive the stick forward (or __mocha.inside.walkTo('cafe')).
- Within 1.5 s, __mocha.inside().k is .95 or more. Within a further 1.2 s, k is 0.
- Then inside() gives on:true, pid:'cafe', who:'you' and world:false, with the walker inside the footprint and within 2.2 of the door.
- roomCam().top is 'room', with pitch .78 ±.03 in portrait and .62 ±.03 in landscape.
- No stick or look input survives the swap: __mocha.ctl().stick.on is false right after the swap.

Only the room renders:
- inside().leaks is [] in the cafe, the bookstore, Mocha's house, Wendell's cottage, the station and the cabin.
- Pixel test after the post pass: 12 sample points outside the room's projected rect are within 14/255 per channel of #1E1612, or darker under B27Ta's CSS vignette.
- No pixel has a sky signature (b > r+40 and b > 150), except on window cards.
- The screenshots go in /tmp/harness/b27t/shots/lf1/ beside /tmp/harness/lookfeel/interior/*-target.png and the mockup shots (i1-cafe, i2-study, i4-cabin), with a one-line verdict each.

Draws (__mocha.drawInfo().calls, main plus shadow):
- the cafe at 10:30: 80 or fewer
- Mocha's house at 19:00: 100 or fewer
- the cabin (after the movingDay skip and cabinLv(2)): 100 or fewer
- The same buildings seen from the street: 300 or more. Report both, and tris (70k or fewer inside).

Characters, with the walker inside the cafe:
- forceAct({p:'cafe',fx:'ask',keeper:'juniper'}): Mocha is drawn.
- Mocha forced home (forceAct({p:'home',s:'couch'})): mocha.visible is false, and his bubble and the edge chip are hidden.
- wForce('cafe') with Wendell on the terrace outside: wObj is not drawn.
- Juniper is drawn.
- A townsfolk with TN[id].inP==='cafe' is drawn; one outside is not.

Watch mode: setCamMode('follow'), then forceAct Mocha to the bookstore.
- Within 3 s of his door pass, inside() gives on:true, pid:'bookstore', who:'mocha'.
- When he leaves, it is off within 3 s of his outward door pass.
- No two transitions are closer than 2.5 s.

Walk out. From inside, drive the walker into the door, and separately tap the 'Go outside' pill.
- After the fade, inside().on is false and world is true.
- The walker is outside the footprint, within 2.5 of the door, facing away from it (±.5 rad).
- The CAM stack has no 'room'; |camS.yaw-(YOU.yaw+π)| < .3; camS.dist is 7 ±.5.

Closed from the street, standing 4 in front of the cafe outside, at 10:30 and 21:00:
- The cafe front group is visible and opaque (no shell material below opacity .99).
- With Mocha forced into his house, he is not drawn, the near pill reads 'Mocha is inside · …', and the B16 window of the room he is in is lit.

Taps inside the cafe:
- A floor tap walks him to the clamped point.
- A tap on Juniper opens talk.
- A tap on the void where a hidden town building lies behind it does nothing outside the room.
- Tapping the 'Go outside' pill exits.

The cabin and decorate:
- From outside the cabin, deco.enter('great') fades into the cabin, then the deco CAM is on top.
- deco.enter('lot') from inside fades out first.
- deco.exit() returns to the room view.
- Tidy, undo and test-B26/test-B27 pass.

Compatibility and regressions:
- test-B12 lines 33-39 still pass: walker(12,22) plus roomTick gives top 'room', pid bookstore, frontFaded and inVis true, and the zoom stays inside the range.
- test-B13, B14, B16, B26, B27, test-B27Ta, test-controls and test-stick pass.
- smoke.js 15 and 21 print OK at DAY=11-03, with no page errors in 3 viewports.
- layoutLint() returns [].

Invariants:
- lights().count is the same outside, inside and after leaving.
- programs().n is +1 or less, and there are 0 new programs across 20 enter/exit cycles after the first.
- inside().swapMs is under 12 on desktop for every swap.
- A 4x-throttled 393x852 profile shows no main-thread task over 100 ms at a swap.
- G.act, G.target and G.mode are identical before and after 20 cycles with the walker. The save size and youSize() are unchanged.

STRETCH, only for what was built:
- Windows: inside.win('home').state is 'day/dry' at 15:00 clear, matches /rain/ after weather('rain'), and is night at 21:00. A lancet pane's mean colour moves toward #2A3260 at night and toward #C9CDD8 by day.
- Sound: inside, audio().zone is 'indoor' or 'home', the wx lowpass is 700 Hz or less, and a 'street' bed has a muffle lowpass of 400 Hz or less.
- The save: a reload inside the cafe at 10:30 boots inside. At 22:00 he is on the doorstep with one toast.
hooks: roomCam() and rooms() keep their shapes; roomCam().frontFaded is true while inside

title: Mocha at the cast's size, and the sea: a real orca and calf with breaches, splashes and spouts (white-sided dolphins in STRETCH)
brief:
DESIGN: /tmp/harness/lookfeel/design.md is binding: sections 0.2 and 2 (LF2A, Mocha's size) and sections 0.3 and 3 (LF2B, the sea), with code anchors. The probe pictures are in /tmp/harness/lookfeel/scale/ (now-* is today, k068-* the proposed size) and /tmp/harness/lookfeel/orca/ (today's orca). Line numbers are for /tmp/harness/base-hf.html (e7d8990); search by function name or quoted anchor. PLAN: /tmp/harness/lookfeel/plan.md. Sections 0 and 2 of /tmp/harness/round2-spec.md still apply.
OWNER (Nov 3, on his iPhone): "Mocha looks really large compared to the other characters, so I would say make his size adjust." And: "I think the dolphin's a really good idea. I think it just looks a bit poorly done. So I'd work on that." The 'dolphin' is today's orca.
GOAL.
- Mocha stands about the cast's height, a touch under the walker, and stays the star: big eyes, the only white glowing figure, readable in follow mode.
- The sea gets an original chibi orca with a calf: proper markings on BOTH flanks, a bending breach with splashes, ripple rings and spouts. Sightings are timed so you actually see them (viewer-aware, favouring golden hour, spouts only at night) and never pass through the piers or the ferry.
- Pacific white-sided dolphins are STRETCH.
About 1 to 1.5 hours: CORE first, STRETCH in order.
TRACK T, step 1 of 4 (first; B27Ta, LF1 and B27Tb follow on the same file).
- Work in /tmp/harness/b27t/index.html (BASE-LF: the hotfix plus seams S0 and L0). Append an LF2 entry to /tmp/harness/b27t/ledger.json. Write /tmp/harness/test-LF2.js.
- Probes: copy /tmp/harness/lookfeel/probe/{common,size,orca}.js into /tmp/harness/b27t/lf2/ and run them through the redirect: NODE_OPTIONS="--require /tmp/harness/redirect.js" MOCHA_FILE=/tmp/harness/b27t/index.html. One browser at a time, generous timeouts, retry once.
- IN (LF1) is still the seam L0 stub in this file: read IN.on only. Tests force it with __mocha.lfForce.in(1,'cafe').
CODE PLACEMENT (TDZ).
- growScale stays on its line; mFloatY and mSeatY go on the lines right after it.
- The SEA block (const SEA and its functions) replaces the `const orca` lines in place, above frame().
- CHIBI_MAT (`const CHIBI_MAT`, about L4319 in base-hf) and PIERS (`const PIERS=`, about L4703) are declared AFTER that spot. Nothing in the SEA block may touch them at top level. Call seaBuild() from one line placed right after the `const PIERS=` line (Track T territory), never at the orca's spot. The mask reads PIERS, FERRY and sails only at runtime.
- The old orca line in frame() becomes `seaFrame(dt);`. That one line is yours; the rest of frame() outside frameUI is Track S's.
- The bubble anchor's umbrella term is in frameUI (Track T).
- Sound recipes go into the B20 SFX table (Track T owns audio).
- SEA.m renders with CHIBI_MAT through mergeParts, for 0 new programs. SEA.fx copies POOLS's material parameters (MeshBasic, map, transparent, additive, depthWrite false, instanceColor), so it reuses that program.
- Register hooks with STYLE.hooks. Register the SEA materials with PREWARM.add.
LEAVE ALONE (Track S territory, seam lines or nobody's; plan.md section 4):
- updateSky, the post shader, resize() and fovK, PAL and AUT, the GLOWPTS shader
- waterMat and waterTex (LF4 adds ripples there)
- frame() outside frameUI and the orca line
- the thumbnail pipeline, catBuild, the menus, Settings
- the seam S0 and L0 lines; holTheme and TOWNTREE; PLACES, ROADS and NAV; the window.__mocha literal; bake() and BAKEM
- the walk controls of controls v3: change only the follow-mode numbers named in A1
CORE, in order. Each item ends with a floor.
A1. The new size (design 2.2 and 2.3).
- growScale()=1.05+.01*Math.min(15,level()-1), and the two helpers mFloatY and mSeatY.
- Every row of the design 2.3 table:
  - the hover height and the bed height
  - the bob, scaled by sc/1.55
  - the cinema seat, the wheel gondola and the ferry deck
  - benches and drop-in seats (benchY), the Needle elevator and the lighthouse top
  - the bubble anchor's umbrella term
  - emotes over Mocha (at least .95)
  - the talk two-shot head (TKW.y+.32*growScale())
  - pets beside him (G.y+.58*growScale(), pet scale 1.0)
- The follow camera: default distance 18 (in the camS init and setCamMode's floor, max(dist,11)), and a follow zoom range of [4.5,80] in zoomLim. These are controls-v3 lines: change only the follow numbers.
- Floor: all.
A2. His face (design 2.4).
- The eyes and their highlights ×1.3, and .02 lower.
- Cheeks, the smile and the O mouth ×1.15.
- Floor: all.
B1. The animals (design 3.1).
- An adult orca (5.2 long) and a calf (2.9 long), with LatheGeometry bodies, a curved dorsal fin, flukes and paddle flippers.
- Patches on BOTH flanks: the eye patch, the chin, the belly, the flank lobe and the saddle.
- Warm black #1E2228, warm white #F4F1EA and saddle grey #9AA3AE; the calf's patches lean peachy (#F2E6DA). Never pure #000 or #FFF.
- Merged with literal-hex colour keys.
- Floor: both animals.
B2. SEA.m and SEA.fx (design 3.2).
- SEA.m is one pre-sized dynamic mesh. While an event is active, its vertices go through the CPU bend deformer and the fluke stroke each frame.
- SEA.fx is one 64-instance FX InstancedMesh with a 4-cell atlas: droplet, foam, ring and mist.
- A manual sphere test; both meshes are invisible when idle.
- Floor: all.
B3. Motion (design 3.3).
- The breach: the pre-roll, the arc and its pitch, the side-splash roll in 50% of breaches, the body arch, the exit and re-entry splashes, and two rings. The calf follows .45 s behind.
- The surfacing spout: the back roll, 8 mist quads and a foam V-wake, as a staggered pass of 2-3 animals.
- Floor: the breach and the spout.
B4. When and where (design 3.4).
- The water mask: x ≤ -110 and |z| ≤ 120; 9 or more from every PIERS rect; 12 or more from the ferry now and 5 s ahead; 10 or more from the sailboats; the heading roughly along the shore.
- The scheduler: one event every 4-7 real minutes.
  - The viewer decides: an event starts only within 140 of the camera and inside the frustum with a 15% margin; otherwise it is deferred.
  - Kinds and odds by hour: golden hour doubles the breaches and places them toward the sun; at night only rare spouts; rain or fog ×.5.
- Nothing starts while IN.on, while a sheet or the map is open (SHEETS.level()>0), or when TIER.n===0 and the frame is over budget.
- The pier-end trigger: the walker within 6 of a pier's west end, facing west, for 6 s or more schedules an event in 4-12 s, 30-45 out, in his view. It fires at most once every 3 minutes.
- Floor: all.
B5. Delete the old orca (its meshes, orcaT, orcaPos and the frame line), and add the hooks. Floor: all.
STRETCH, in priority order:
- S1. Mocha's moment. His 'orca spotting' hobby, or G.ride==='ferry' in watch mode, schedules an event in his view within 20 s. He reacts with a startle-joy emote and a bubble ('ORCAS!! 🐋' or 'a calf!!'), and a diary memory and a news line go through the existing mem and newsPush paths. This is visual only: never write G.act, G.target or G.mode.
- S2. Sounds, positional {x,z}:
  - 'spout': bandpassed noise at 700-1200 Hz, .45 s
  - 'splash', 'splashS' and 'whoosh'
  - All are muffled when IN.on once LF1 lands.
- S3. Pacific white-sided dolphins (3-5): porpoising crossings, and bow-riding the ferry on every third departure the viewer can see.
- S4. A pod of 3; spyhop and tail-slap; gulls circling a breach spot; one GLOWPTS glint on golden-hour spray (glowPt only).
- S5. Size extras:
  - a pale night pool under Mocha (one POOLS slot, k .22, #B8C4FF)
  - a level-up grow moment
  - re-render the scene mockups at the new size in a copy, /tmp/harness/b27t/mock-lf2/ (KIT.mocha scale 1.05, hover .24+.525), and shoot i1-cafe, i2-study and e1-square in portrait for the owner. Never edit the repo's previews folder in this run.
BUDGET.
- Idle: SEA adds 0 draws, and no CPU beyond the scheduler.
- During an event: +2 draws or fewer, and seaFrame takes .6 ms or less on desktop SwiftShader.
- Programs +0 (document any +1). No new lights.
- State: none in CORE. S1 may add a seen counter of 30 bytes or less in S.town.
- The size change adds 0 draws and changes no walker or cast numbers.
AUTONOMY. The size change and the sea write no G.act, G.target or G.mode and add no userBias term; the bias audit is unchanged.
HANDOFF. Report:
- the size table: Mocha's world top and hem at levels 1 and 16, his on-screen height against the walker in the walk and follow cams, and the eye px at follow distance 18
- the seat contact table
- frozen orca shots from both sides at u=.2, .5 and .8, and a spout
- the event costs, the mask stats and a scheduler log over 30 simulated minutes
- known_issues
acceptance:

title: Menus that never freeze: a quiet town behind sheets, input first, pictures and previews off the tap path, sliced arrival builds, no late shader compiles
brief: DESIGN: /tmp/harness/lookfeel/menus-quality.md is binding: - section 2: what was measured - section 3: the causes, F1 to F9, with code anchors - section 4: the LF3 brief (M1 to M9), acceptance A1 to A11, and the hooks The probes and today's numbers are in /tmp/harness/lookfeel/menus/: instr.js, probe-menus.js, probe-light.js, probe-progs.js, probe-canvas.js and prof-frame.js; menus-1x.json and menus-4x.json are the baseline. PLAN: /tmp/harness/lookfeel/plan.md. Sections 0 and 2 of /tmp/harness/round2-spec.md still apply. OWNER (Nov 3, on his iPhone): "Some of the menus kind of freeze up when you're using them." Earlier that morning: "When I was at the cafe, it froze." GOAL. - No tap waits more than about a frame, and no menu does more than about a frame's work inside a tap. - Pictures and previews arrive progressively instead of freezing the screen. - The town rests behind sheets. - Nothing compiles shaders after warm-up. - Walking and watching cost the same or less. About 1 to 1.5 hours: CORE first. TRACK S, step 3 of 4 (after B27Sa and B27Sb; LF4 follows on the same file). - Work in /tmp/harness/b27s/index.html. Append an LF3 entry to /tmp/harness/b27s/ledger.json. Write /tmp/harness/test-LF3.js. - Copy the menus probes into /tmp/harness/b27s/lf3/ and run them on the track file through the redirect (NODE_OPTIONS="--require /tmp/harness/redirect.js" MOCHA_FILE=/tmp/harness/b27s/index.html), at CPU rates 1 and 4, with the same seeded save. Your 'before' is the track file at the start of this step. The probe's no-raster mode measures main-thread cost only. One browser at a time. ALREADY IN THE FILE (seam L0; do not redo): - Mocha's lantern light is scene-level and dimmed instead of hidden (M5's lantern fix). - The SHEETS registry and the UIQ stub, with SHEETS.set calls at every sheet open and close. - frame()'s cap is Math.min(TIER.fps(),UIQ.fps()), and its render gate is UIQ.render(T,dt). - frameUI's label pass is gated on UIQ.level<2 and UIQ.hot. - PREWARM.add exists, and other steps register samples with it. From now on you own the SHEETS, UIQ and PREWARM lines and fill in their behaviour. CODE PLACEMENT (TDZ). - Edit the existing functions in place. - New modules (PIX, the atlas code for THB, the PREWARM job, lightsLint) go in ONE LF3 block right after the seam L0 block, as definitions only. - At top level that block touches no scene object, renderer state or DOM node; the only exception is the two capture-phase listeners. - Work that needs late objects (the preview scene, the PREWARM job) starts from frame(), which is yours, on the first idle frames after boot. - Never insert lines before the script's final `})();`: that spot is LF1's. TERRITORY (plan.md section 4). - Yours: - frame() outside frameUI, and updateSky's shadow-freeze term - project(), HUD.layout and its callers, ltSync, fitMsgs - renderFeed, renderMe, lbItems/showLB and the away card - the thumbnail pipeline: thRender, thumb, thPump, thFill, THB, catPage's cells, shRender's previews, dTrayDraw's cells - catBuild, catTick, catDrop - toggleMap/drawBigMap; takeSelfie/savePhotos and the save interval - Not yours: - Your Look (ylClick, ylRender, applyLook, lookOpen, lookClose) belongs to B27Tb, which delivers M3's Your Look item in Track T - frameUI (Track T: LF1, later LF5) - catMerge, CATB and the catalog data (B27Tb) - updateMocha (Track T) - Keep thumb(code,v,sil,cb) and thFill(host) working for `` markup, which B27Tb adds in its own UI: thFill swaps each such img for a canvas cell (or draws into it), with no encode. CORE, in order. Each item ends with a floor. M1. A quiet world and input first (F3). - UIQ.fps(): on touch, 15 behind half sheets and 24 behind Your Look; otherwise no cap. Desktop is untouched. - UIQ.render: 4 Hz behind full covers, and never while UIQ.hot. - Shadows: while UIQ.level ≥ 1, sun.shadow.autoUpdate=false with one needsUpdate per second, combined with updateSky's night freeze. Restore on close. - Input first: capture-phase passive pointerdown and pointerup listeners set UIQ.hot to now+150 ms. They ignore the canvas, the stick, the look area and the decorate pad, so controls v3 keeps full-rate rendering under the thumbs. - Floor: all. M2. Pictures off the tap path (F1). - The PIX module returns canvas cells: a placeholder at once, then the real paint in idle slices of 6 ms, nearest the viewport first. An IntersectionObserver watches the open tab; canvases beyond three screens are released. - Rewire renderFeed, renderMe's painting grid and postcards, lbItems/showLB and the away card. - An idle prefetch paints the newest 6 paintings and 2 postcards. - Floor: Feed, Me and the viewer. M4. Previews, batched and asynchronous (F2). - Up to 16 previews per 512x512 atlas render. - One read-back per batch: through a PBO and fenceSync on WebGL2, one synchronous read on WebGL1. - Cells are canvases drawn from the atlas page; silhouettes are derived in 2D. - thPump runs after the main render: one batch every 3 frames, never while hot, visible cells first. - Pre-warm the preview materials. - Floor: the batch and the asynchronous read-back. M8. Arrival builds, sliced (F8). - catBuild builds one shelf or surface group per frame from a generator. It never runs while UIQ.hot, or while a door swap is running (IN.ph!=='idle'). - Teleports start it after the arrival fade. - Floor: all. M5. No compiles after warm-up (F4). - The PREWARM job: after the boot compile, 2 samples per idle slice, using KHR_parallel_shader_compile where present. It covers the registry plus the preview, catalog display, decorate and selfie noBend samples. - __mocha.lightsLint(). - After prewarm().done, any new program logs STUCKLOG 'prog+N during X'. - Floor: the job and the lint. M3. Targeted updates (F5), except Your Look. - onDiary marks the open tab dirty (TABS.dirty). The tab re-renders in an idle slice with scrollTop kept, never while hot. - The feed heart updates in place. - feedSync adds and removes posts by data-id. - Floor: the heart and the dirty marking. M6. Layout (F6). - project() reads cached VW and VH, set in resize(). - The per-second HUD.layout() leaves frame(). HUD.dirty is set on slot, visibility, mode and resize changes, and the layout runs in a rAF read phase. - ltSync and fitMsgs read geometry in the next rAF, never in the task that just changed classes or innerHTML. - Floor: project() and HUD.layout. STRETCH, in priority order: - S1. M7, the map: the static layer is cached offscreen, and the 4 Hz tick draws only the moving dots. - S2. M9: while a sheet is open, the selfie (up to 60 s), savePhotos, catBuild/catDrop and occRebuild wait. The selfie read-back uses the PBO path and toBlob. save() runs through idle(). - S3. The diary prepends new entries, with a 60-entry window and a 'more' sentinel. - S4. The IndexedDB preview cache; an OffscreenCanvas worker for paintCanvas and cardCanvas; __mocha.inp(). BUDGET. - PHONE frames: draws and tris unchanged on the frozen fixed views (the B27S ledger views, DAY=11-03). - Programs after prewarm: the same as before this step, plus 1 or fewer (the preview atlas variant). - No new lights. No new save fields: the preview cache lives in memory; IndexedDB only in STRETCH. - PIX canvases are bounded: at most 3 screens are kept. AUTONOMY. Deferring work never changes what Mocha does or what he writes in his diary; only the pixels wait. HANDOFF. Report: - the before/after table for A1 to A11 at 1x and 4x (the menus probe on the track file before and after) - the frame-cap and render-gate rules as built, and the SHEETS cover per sheet - the PREWARM list and the program count after warm-up - what the merge glue must re-check: Your Look taps from B27Tb, thFill on B27Tb's markup, LF1's door swaps with catBuild, the cafe flow for LF5 - known_issues
acceptance:

title: High and Ultra graphics for computers: one TIER object, auto-detection with a saved decision, and a Graphics setting (PHONE unchanged)
brief:
DESIGN: /tmp/harness/lookfeel/menus-quality.md section 5 (the LF4 brief) is binding: the tiers, detection and the probe, each feature's how, cost and fallback, the phone rule, CORE and STRETCH, the sign-offs, acceptance T1 to T10, and the hooks. Addendum S (S5 and S16) still governs the art and the PHONE budget. B41 later extends this TIER object; never build a second system. PLAN: /tmp/harness/lookfeel/plan.md. Sections 0 and 2 of /tmp/harness/round2-spec.md still apply.
OWNER (Nov 3): "If there's a better way to make the graphics look better, like if it needs to be more on a computer, that's okay. But I do think this could use a better outcome. It could look better."
GOAL. One TIER object with four levels:
- LOW (battery saver)
- PHONE: today's look and cost after B27S, unchanged
- HIGH: good phones, tablets and modest computers
- ULTRA: computers
HIGH and ULTRA render the same art the owner's references show, the way they show it: soft contact shadows, glow at dusk, a crisp miniature blur, dense leaves, long hazy views. Every feature has a capability check and a PHONE fallback. The tier is detected automatically, remembered per device, and can be overridden in a Graphics setting. About 1 to 1.5 hours: CORE first.
TRACK S, step 4 of 4 (last; after B27Sa, B27Sb and LF3 on the same file).
- Work in /tmp/harness/b27s/index.html. Append an LF4 entry to /tmp/harness/b27s/ledger.json. Write /tmp/harness/test-LF4.js.
- SwiftShader cannot judge GPU speed. The harness tests correctness, structure and PHONE parity; speed is judged on the owner's computer with ?gfxhud=1.
SEAM L0 (yours from now on):
- the TIER stub in the L0 block right after `const STYLE`, and the tierInit() call at the end of that block (the renderer and the scene already exist there; the world is not built yet)
- frame()'s cap is Math.min(TIER.fps(),UIQ.fps()); UIQ is LF3's
Track T code reads TIER.n, TIER.farOut and SET.saver: keep SET.saver true exactly when the tier is LOW, and keep TIER.farOut equal to the outdoor camera.far.
CODE PLACEMENT (TDZ).
- tierInit() reads the capabilities and decides the tier. It sets plain fields (TIER.n, TIER.boot, TIER.f with dens, far and the others) that the world builders read later. It touches nothing declared below the L0 block: `const post`, the litter and bush builders, CHARLOD and catTick all come later.
- Your other definitions (tierGuess, applyTier, the blue-noise texture painter) go in ONE LF4 block right after the L0 block (and after LF3's block), as definitions only.
- Builders multiply their counts by TIER.f.dens where they already run.
- Values that live on later objects (the post defines, sun.shadow, CHARLOD's fields, catTick's distances, PR) are applied by applyTier(). It runs from a first-frame guard inside frame() (`if(!TIER.applied)applyTier()`) and on every switch.
- Never insert lines before the script's final `})();`: that spot is LF1's.
SIGN-OFF GATE.
- Bloom at ULTRA needs the Addendum S5 amendment (menus-quality 5.6). Build it only if /tmp/harness/lookfeel/signoff.json has "bloomUltra": true. Otherwise ULTRA's glow is GLOWPTS ×1.4.
- The program budget: ULTRA +6 or fewer, compiled behind the tier-apply fade. LOW, PHONE and HIGH add 0; HIGH's 12-tap variant replaces its own program.
RUNTIME CONTRACTS (plan.md section 5):
- Track T's indoor overrides (LF1, B27Ta) go through STYLE.skyHooks, which run last in updateSky, and through STYLE.shadowHalf. While shadowHalf is set, your tight fit and texel snap stand aside and never move sun.target.
- Never write camera.far while IN.on: write TIER.farOut, which LF1 restores on leave.
- Set CHARLOD's d0, dh, max and nsh by assignment from your block, never inside CHARLOD.tick (Track T edits it).
- Density and distance read TIER.boot before the world is built; live parts (PR, frame cap, shadows, post) apply at once.
LEAVE ALONE: Track T territory (frameUI, updateMocha, the rooms, IN and WORLD, CHARLOD.tick, audio, B27Tb's wardrobe and catalog); the seam lines other than TIER and tierInit; holTheme and TOWNTREE; PLACES, ROADS and NAV; the window.__mocha literal; bake() and BAKEM.
CORE, in order. Each item ends with a floor.
G1. TIER and the decision (5.1 and 5.2).
- tierInit() reads the capabilities.
- tierGuess(caps) is a pure function.
- localStorage 'mocha-gfx' holds {v,sig,tier,guess,probe,drops}.
- TIER.boot drives the structural parts.
- SET.gfx is one of 'auto', 'low', 'phone', 'high' and 'ultra'; SET.saver migrates to 'low'.
- Floor: all.
G2. The Graphics row in Settings: Auto · <pick> / Battery saver / Phone / High / Ultra.
- Live parts apply within 1 s, behind a 300 ms fade.
- Structural parts show 'more trees and longer views after reload' with a Reload button.
- Ultra on a touch device shows the warm-battery note.
- PHONE, HIGH and ULTRA never toggle castShadow or shadowMap.type.
- Floor: all.
G3. Resolution and frame rate (5.3.1): the pixel budget PR=min(tierCap, sqrt(maxPixels/(w·h))), identical to today on PHONE, and TIER.fps per tier. Floor: all.
G4. Shadows (5.3.2): HIGH uses 2048 with PCF radius 3, the tight box centred ahead and texel snapping; ULTRA uses 4096. Resize by disposing the map. Floor: all.
G5. Post (5.3.5 and 5.3.6).
- TS_TAPS 6, 12 or 16 as a define in the post shader. The band (STYLE.tsBand) and the gating (STYLE.noTs) are unchanged.
- A 64x64 blue-noise dither (±.5/255) on HIGH and ULTRA.
- Floor: all.
G6. Density and distance (5.3.7, 5.3.8, the LOD row and 5.3.10).
- TIER.dens (.6/1/1.4/2) applies to the fall litter, the bushes, and B27Sb's DB and leaf piles, as strict prefixes of one seeded sequence.
- TIER.far (.8/1/1.25/1.6) applies to the fog (including the autumn haze), camera.far outdoors, BEND's flat radius, CHARLOD's distances and counts, catTick's show and hide distances, and the GLOWPTS fog.
- Anisotropy per tier.
- Floor: all.
G7. ADAPT, demote only (5.2).
- Below .65x the tier cap for 4 s, step down one live feature, in this order: bloom, SAO, depth tilt-shift, 4096, 2048, pixel ratio −.25, then the tier.
- TIER.drops is saved; 2 drops in a session lower the saved tier.
- It never promotes.
- Floor: all.
G8. ?gfxhud=1 (tier, fps, frame ms, GPU ms where available, PR, drawn MP), and the hooks. Floor: all.
STRETCH, in priority order:
- S1. SAO at ULTRA (5.3.3): a DepthTexture on rt; half-resolution SAO tinted with the mauve shadow colour, folded into the post composite. Plus depth-weighted tilt-shift taps at ULTRA.
- S2. tierProbe (5.2):
  - a 2.5 s measure, the promotion rule, and a 2.5 s trial with revert
  - a re-probe per sig, every 14 days, or after 2 drops
  - phones stop at HIGH
- S3. Warm mip-chain bloom at ULTRA (5.3.4), only with sign-off.
- S4. Water (5.3.9), on HIGH and ULTRA: the 'wv' ripple PATCH on waterMat and the lamp-streak InstancedMesh (+1 draw).
- S5. Dried-grass tufts on HIGH and ULTRA (+1 draw, no shadows).
- S6. The far cascade, full depth-of-field tilt-shift, the planar water reflection, MSAA 8, the half-float chain, and KHR_parallel_shader_compile for tier switches.
BUDGET.
- PHONE: identical to the step's start file in draws, tris, programs, textures, render targets and pixels (T1).
- HIGH: +2 draws or fewer (the tufts and streaks, both STRETCH).
- ULTRA: full-screen passes only; programs +6 or fewer; RT plus shadow memory 160 MB or less at 2560x1440.
- No new THREE lights.
- State: SET.gfx and 'mocha-gfx' only; S is untouched.
HANDOFF. Report:
- the tier table as built (f per tier) and tierGuess's table
- the PHONE parity numbers
- PHONE, HIGH and ULTRA shots at 15:30 and 21:00 (ext-walk-square-cozy, ext-street-homes, ext-follow-ui) in /tmp/harness/b27s/shots/lf4/, each set beside its reference (s1 to s4), with a one-line verdict
- the program and memory counts per tier
- what the merge glue must re-check: ULTRA inside rooms, LF1's void and shadow fit at every tier, Track T's SET.saver readers
- known_issues
